title: One decision trail handed to an offline federation edge

fault.description: For a negative case, the single fault seeded; null for a positive case.

execution.description: Optional members are evidence, not defaults: a verifier that needs one and does not find it answers NOT_ESTABLISHED for that claim, never an assumed value. executed=false together with an APPLIED twin record or an observation is a trail that disagrees with itself (CONTRADICTED).

dispatched_at_sim_s.description: Needed by observation_after_dispatch; absent or null means that claim is NOT_ESTABLISHED.

executions.description: Needed by single_dispatch; absent means that claim is NOT_ESTABLISHED (never assumed to be 1).

twin_operation.description: The twin's own operation record for operation_id = proposal_id (an independent witness).

observation.description: null means the effect was not observed (NOT_ESTABLISHED for declared_effect_observed). Optional members are evidence, not defaults.

observed_setpoint_c.description: Needed by declared_effect_observed; absent means that claim is NOT_ESTABLISHED.

observed_at_sim_s.description: Needed by observation_after_dispatch; absent means that claim is NOT_ESTABLISHED (never assumed to equal the dispatch time).

remora_evidence.description: REMORA's evidence bundle for the proposal, verbatim.

remora_envelope.description: REMORA's DecisionEnvelope for the proposal, verbatim.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON of remora_evidence: keys sorted, separators "," and ":" with no whitespace, ensure_ascii false (Python json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)).
